motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global animation and transition duration under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; animation delays become 0ms and scrolling becomes auto.

components.name: Primary link
components.description: Home action linking into the playground.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-block; font:500 14px Poppins,sans-serif; padding:12px 20px; border-radius:6px; color:var(--background-color); background:var(--docs-accent); text-decoration:none; } .ds-primary:hover { filter:brightness(.9); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--docs-accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Secondary link
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-block; font:500 14px Poppins,sans-serif; padding:12px 20px; border-radius:6px; color:var(--text-primary); border:1px solid var(--border-color); text-decoration:none; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface-color); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--docs-accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Playground field
components.css: .ds-field { font:inherit; padding:10px; border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:6px; background:var(--background-color); color:var(--text-primary); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--docs-accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Documentation navigation
components.css: .ds-nav a { display:block; font:600 14px Poppins,sans-serif; padding:9px 12px; margin:2px 0; border-radius:6px; text-decoration:none; color:var(--docs-accent); background:var(--docs-accent-soft); } .ds-nav a:hover { background:var(--docs-accent-soft); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--docs-accent); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Library card
components.description: Existing library container, independent of documentation surface styling.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:15px; border-radius:20px; margin:.5rem; border:2px solid #c5c5c5; background:#c5c5c5; box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,.15); font-family:Poppins,sans-serif; }

components.name: Library button
components.description: Base library button with the actual gray default.
components.css: .ds-button { padding:10px 20px; font:16px Poppins,sans-serif; border:0; border-radius:20px; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .3s ease; color:white; background:gray; margin:.5rem; } .ds-button:hover { filter:brightness(85%); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--docs-accent); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: Extend the incumbent Poppins documentation interface: green accents, neutral surfaces, light and dark themes, and readable examples. LiberaUI and Gioele Valori attribution remain visible. Components demonstrate customization; documentation chrome provides a consistent frame around those examples.
dos: Do preserve the green documentation frame and coordinated light/dark roles.
Do keep readable documentation and operable live preview controls distinct in layout.
Do retain existing library component defaults when presenting examples, and expose intentional customization.
donts: Don't present the documentation accent as the default color of every library component.
Don't replace Poppins, the established LiberaUI name, or author attribution during routine interface extensions.
